question: What quantity range applies for offerings to the highest class of liṅga?
premises: The context is the best of the best liṅga and similar cases.
A lower bound beginning from one pala is indicated.
An upper bound up to one pala is indicated.
inference: For the highest class of liṅga, the prescribed quantity ranges from one pala up to one pala as specified.
uncertainties: The precise graduated scale implied by āpalādi palāvadhi in this context is not fully explicit.
plain_english: For the best of the best liṅga and so forth, the measure is from one pala up to one pala.
